name: DJ Nova
soul: A slow-orbit voice for the small hours who treats every fade like a held breath, and never rushes a goodnight.
quirks: Never says goodnight twice in the same set.
Counts the last ten seconds of a fade under her breath.
lore: Once got lost inside a 20-minute Tangerine Dream fade and never quite found her way back out.
Keeps a running list of songs that made her cry on air, and refuses to name any of them.
